business_problem: Loxam needed an integrated employee-service and IT service management environment that could replace siloed systems across multiple countries, speed up support responses, and simplify HR and IT processes for staff.
solution_summary: Loxam standardized employee support on ServiceNow IT Service Management to replace siloed country-specific tools with one multilingual portal spanning eight countries. The ITSM portal became the front door for incidents, employee requests, HR content, and lifecycle workflows such as onboarding, offboarding, and transfers, so staff no longer navigate separate systems. Performance Analytics gives the central support organization incident traceability and KPI measurement, while Dynamic Translation lets employees submit and receive support in their own language. Virtual Agent adds natural-language guidance so users can resolve or route issues through automated conversational flows instead of waiting on manual handoffs. The same platform now coordinates IT and broader business workflows, turning ServiceNow into a one-stop employee-service layer that accelerates resolution and lowers the cost of redesigning supporting applications.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Provides the shared portal and workflow layer for incidents, employee requests, and staff lifecycle processes across multiple countries.

solution_components.name: Performance Analytics
solution_components.role: Measures KPIs and incident traceability so the central support team can monitor and improve service performance.

solution_components.name: Dynamic Translation
solution_components.role: Lets employees communicate with support teams in their own language through the portal.

solution_components.name: Virtual Agent
solution_components.role: Guides users through requests and issue resolution with natural-language interactions.

data_flow: Employees enter the ITSM portal for incidents, HR content, onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and other business requests. Dynamic Translation localizes those interactions, Virtual Agent guides the user through automated conversational steps, and the resulting cases flow through centralized support workflows while Performance Analytics tracks traceability and KPI performance across countries.
business_outcome: Loxam created a single employee-service portal for eight countries, reduced key process times from weeks to 72 hours, simplified HR and IT support workflows, and cut application redesign costs while giving staff a more consistent multilingual support experience.
metrics: 72 Hours to complete process that once took weeks
